responsibility: Declares the function-summary data model used by GCC’s IPA inliner and specialization analyses. It defines summary classes for function size/time/stack estimates, call-site estimates, inline hints, predicate-conditioned cost tables, loop-frequency predicates, and cached call-context evaluation, together with the public APIs for querying, dumping, updating, and merging these summaries after inlining or cloning. It is the interface side of ipa-fnsummary.cc, not the pass driver itself.
same_name_distinction: Defines the summary classes, estimate/result structures, hint enums, and public query/update APIs consumed by inlining and specialization code. Unlike gcc/ipa-fnsummary.cc, it does not execute summary generation or streaming passes; it describes the data model and callable interface.
